headline_marked: Bad light ends day as [[Shadman Islam finishes on 99 not out]] in Mirpur Test
headline: Bad light ends day as Shadman Islam finishes on 99 not out in Mirpur Test
summary: Bangladesh reached 213/3 after 74 overs against West Indies, with Shadman Islam just one run short of a century after a resilient performance.
details: Shadman Islam ended the first day of the Mirpur Test against West Indies unbeaten on 99, falling just one run short of a century due to fading light.
Bangladesh finished the day at 213 for three after 74 overs, building a strong platform for the second day.
This is only the 20th time in Test cricket history that a batter has finished a day's play on 99 not out, with Mushfiqur Rahim being the only other Bangladeshi batter to achieve this.
Shadman faced 219 balls and hit 10 fours, showing great patience against a moving new ball.
Tanzid Hasan (7) and Mominul Haque were early wickets, while captain Najmul Hossain Shanto (19) was trapped lbw by Jomel Warrican.
Towhid Hridoy contributed 42 runs from 84 balls before being stretchered off the field due to severe leg cramps in the heat and humidity.
Litton Das, returning from a hip injury, remained unbeaten on 10 when play was finally called off.
Jomel Warrican finished the day with figures of 2 for 33, while Jayden Seales took one wicket.

headline_marked: 12 women [[rescued from human trafficking ring]] in Dhaka
headline: 12 women rescued from human trafficking ring in Dhaka
summary: The victims were lured by promises of high-paying jobs in China but were instead held captive and tortured by traffickers.
details: The Special Response Battalion (SRB-1) rescued 12 women from two different locations in Dhaka after they were held captive for human trafficking purposes.
The victims, who were brought from Chattogram to Dhaka, were lured with promises of high-paying jobs and various benefits in China.
According to the SRB, the women were held in houses without valid passports or travel documents and were subjected to physical and mental torture.
The traffickers also reportedly pressured the victims to engage in immoral activities while they were being held captive.
The rescue operation began after a missing person's report was filed at the Baizid Bostami police station in Chattogram regarding two missing women.
The first group of women was rescued from the Jamjam Tower area of Uttara West police station on Monday afternoon.
Following the information provided by the victims, another 10 women were rescued from the Vatara area later that night.
The rescued women have been handed over to their families, and the SRB is currently processing legal cases and conducting raids to arrest the suspects.
